name: Variety Show
description: Come watch your friends: Sing, Dance, Act and more!! Dress Rehearsal for those participating in the show is on Thursday, March 19th, 2026 @ 4:00pm. The Show is on Friday, March 20th, 2026 @ 4:00pm at The Stage at Los Alamitos. Bring your family and friends for a fun-filled early evening!!

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos this week! Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: PARENTS: A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance. Due to time constraints, solo and duo performances are encouraged to perform at the Los Alamitos Variety Show on March 20th.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!
